Capability manifest for (the .pa-table container) — svelte-pure-admin. See definition-list.map.json / list.map.json for the container-only model. CONTAINER-ONLY by construction: Table.svelte is `
{@render children()}
` — a pure shell whose thead/tbody rows are native children the consumer writes inside the slot. Siblings TableContainer/TableResponsive/TableCard wrap it; this is the plain element. isCompact (= size xs, same pa-table--xs class) is svelte-only sugar and is covered by the `size` enum — not a separate oracle feature.
